description.value: Walnut Beach Resort is a lakefront suite hotel occupying Osoyoos Lake's only private beach, set against vineyard-covered hills in Canada's only desert region. Suites feature fully equipped kitchens, and the on-site Pointe 49 Kitchen & Bar provides casual dining with patio seating and lake views. The resort bills itself as a gateway to Okanagan wine touring, golf, and cycling in one of British Columbia's warmest and most scenic valleys.

address.value: 4200 Lakeshore Drive, Osoyoos, British Columbia, Canada V0H 1V6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates OSM address, local phone number, and confirms the property is open (active booking, copyright 2026). The amenities page explicitly lists 'Complimentary WiFi' confirming the OSM internet_access=wlan tag. No bike-specific facilities (storage, tools, wash, charging) are mentioned anywhere in the fetched content; the FAQ references a 'parking garage' in the non-smoking policy but never connects it to bicycle storage.
concerns: Website banner states 'Our phone lines are currently down' — cyclists may be unable to reach the property by phone; email contact (info@walnutbeachresort.com) is offered as an alternative.
Website prominently displays a toll-free number (1-855-936-5400) not present in OSM tags; the local number (250-495-5400) is consistent with OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly bookable lakefront resort in Osoyoos with confirmed web presence and active reservations; straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists in the Okanagan.
